quotes.title: K2-38b
quotes.card: K2-38b, also designated EPIC 204221263 b, is a massive rocky exoplanet closely orbiting a Sun-like star and is one of the densest planets ever found.
quotes.introduction: Discovered in 2016 by Crossfield et al. and later characterized by Sinukoff et al., K2-38b is a rocky super-Earth about 55% larger than Earth but about 12 times more massive indicating a composition rich in iron and an extremely high surface gravity.

notes: K2-38 b: Toledo-Padrón et al. 2020's mass 0.02296837 Jupiter masses in 0.13738983 Jupiter radii is 11.0 g/cm^3, outside what the records accept
